Maya (CSM): quick sync 1 1 1 0 0 0  WillowHealth wants to shorten renewal to 9 months and true-down seats from 20 -> 15. Procurement says they need a new PO + an amendment before we send DocuSign. Who's owning what?
Evan (WillowHealth): correct. CFO aligned—same per-seat rate, shorter term. We'll send a PO referencing original contract id.
Tom (Finance): net30 ok from our side. PO must include billing entity name, vendor_code, and tax ID. Prefer PDF.
Maya (CSM): sample PO payload provided to Procurement: { "po_number": "<PO#>", "billing_entity": "WillowHealth, Inc.", "vendor_code": "<vendor_code>", "amount": "<USD>", "term_months": "9", "tax_id": "<EIN>" }
Miguel (RevOps): vendor_code options: 8491-US or 8491-EU. Which one?
Evan (WillowHealth): this is US entity -> 8491-US. Also request amendment labeled Amendment v2 and reference contract 7492-RED.
Nina (Legal): I'll draft Amendment v2 (term change + seat reduction + proration). Need counterparty legal contact to speed review. If they can return redlines in 48hrs we can meet billing cutoff.
Evan (WillowHealth): Jess Carter (jess.carter@willowhealth.com) is our legal. I'll loop her in.
Diego (Onboarding): training roster needs update; I'll remove 5 seats and rebook remaining 15. Suggest week-of-21 for enablement. To avoid mid-session issues, entitlement change should go live at start of next month after PO clears.
Maya (CSM): action list: Nina to send draft; Tom confirmed net30 and fields; Evan to send PO with vendor_code and tax id; Diego to hold week-of-21 and update entitlement on 1st next month; I will open DocuSign when docs attached.
docusign-bot: Envelope placeholder created 1 EnvID: ab12cd34 awaiting signatures.
Miguel (RevOps): SOW filename for billing automation must be SOW_Willow_2026_Amendment_v2.pdf and include original contract id 7492-RED in metadata.
Maya (CSM): recap: Evan sends PO by tomorrow EOD (8491-US, tax id, billing entity); Nina finalizes amendment and sends to Jess; Tom OK net30; Diego to schedule enablement and set entitlement change; I will kick DocuSign on docs arrival.
Evan (WillowHealth): will send PO tomorrow, looping Jess. Ping if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
Maya (CSM): I'll update the renewal record in Gainsight with new term and seats and post checklist here.
